name: pf-plan-specs
about: plan-specs against the built packages classes, specs instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). Test plan through the plan_specs bot: the 4th specializations (mods/specs) cast in an emptied Bandit Keep floor at level 20. winddancer: Protective Gale puts gale_1 (Evasion, 6 s, HUD icon) on the rogue; an evade (the evade verb: Player.Evade's real roll) heals 20 through Second Wind, a second within 4 s does not; the orbs' binds take (Lasting Gale 12 s, Tailwind, Lingering Breeze, Shared Breath), the recast lasts 12 s with Tailwind's speed, a gust gives breeze_2, and the rogue never gets the teammates' share buff. bannerlord: the raise gives standard_dr at 2%, Feared Crest and War Drum debuff a dummy, Shared Provisions counts the buff; the second press plants it for free at 4%. invocation (Aerotheurge): Thunder Orb zaps all three dummies in a row; the orbs' binds take (Lightning Rod 5 zaps within 95); two spell casts with no enemy give 2 Static Charge, a third 7.5 s later keeps all three past the first 10 s and they go 10 s after it; 3 stacks give conduit_2_3; at 5 the next cast releases them (stacks 0) and Charged Font gives 20% mana back; the 5 s orb with Thunderclap hurts all three again. stormbringer (Deadeye): Lightning Arrow hits a dummy on the line and strikes the one beside it, and its 3 arrows come back (hp falls again); the orb binds; every 5 kills by the ranger give a Tailwind stack; two stacks 2 s apart end 4 s after their own kill; 35 kills stop at 5 stacks with the level's tailwind speed buff; Gale Force shoots 2 arrows at 5; Wind Ward 3% a stack; a still ranger catches the arrows (Tailwind). branding: a Pyrebrand press brands a dummy, Demon's Tail feeds it and the skill is ready again; the recast's claw is the base plus the stored damage, free, then the full cooldown; a brand that runs out claws on its own; a dying victim passes it on; a lone victim dying with nobody to take the brand starts the full cooldown; the orb binds; Essence Extraction's max; Essence Empowerment adds 3% fire per stack; Combustion spends 10 Essence for a 56 radius; Proliferation's brand is 3 s and goes to all 3 dummies; melee hits on a branded elite give Essence once per the cooldown; Released Essence gives 6 for an elite the claw kills. arcane: Living Mana adds max health to max mana and keeps health at the mana fraction; health given turns into mana and health taken drains it; a real hit drains the mana; a cast stops at 1 mana; Blink moves the dodge's distance and hits a dummy where it lands; with a dash charge it recasts Static Discharge from the start, without one it does not; the orb binds; Far Step 35% farther; Arcane Feedback banks the mana a hit took and the next spell's damage multiplier takes it; the bank skips a Blink and goes to the next elemental spell; no Mana Conduit with no teammates; Void Barrier survives a lethal hit after a Blink; regeneration is faster at low mana; a hit past the pool kills.

allow: Resource name hash conflict in package 'mods/(HWP-[a-z0-9]+|HammerwatchPlus-All)(-gamelab)?\.bin' for file
